transitions.operation_detail: Oligo-dT30VN anneals to the poly(A) tail (72 C 3 min denaturation) and SuperScript II M-MLV synthesizes first-strand cDNA at 42 C for 90 min followed by ten 50 C/42 C cycles in 1 M betaine with elevated MgCl2; 70 C enzyme inactivation folded in.

major_reagents.name: SuperScript II reverse transcriptase (M-MLV terminal transferase activity)

transitions.operation_detail: When the reverse transcriptase reaches the 5' end of the RNA its terminal transferase activity adds 2-5 untemplated nucleotides (predominantly dC) to the cDNA 3' end.

Template switching: the TSO 3' rGrG+G anneals to the untemplated C-tail and M-MLV switches template, extending the cDNA with the complement of the TSO so that both cDNA ends carry the same ISPCR handle.

Single-primer semi-suppressive preamplification with the ISPCR primer and KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix (98 C 3 min; 18 cycles of 98 C 20 s / 67 C 15 s / 72 C 6 min; final 72 C 5 min); 1:1 AMPure XP cleanup, elution and Bioanalyzer QC folded in.

major_reagents.name: Nextera XT Amplicon Tagment Mix (hyperactive Tn5 transposome)

transitions.operation_detail: Nextera (XT) Tn5 transposome (Amplicon Tagment Mix in Tagment DNA Buffer, 55 C 5 min, at most 1 ng input) fragments the amplified cDNA and simultaneously transfers the s5- and s7-mosaic-end adapters, leaving a 9-nt gap on each strand next to the annealed non-transferred mosaic-end oligo; Tn5 is then stripped with NT buffer. Fragments carrying s5 at both ends or s7 at both ends are also produced but are not amplifiable in the semi-suppressive enrichment PCR, so only the s5/s7 product is carried forward.
The 72 C, 3 min step that opens the Nextera enrichment PCR fills the 9-nt gaps and extends each strand across the opposite adapter, yielding a fully double-stranded s5/s7 fragment.

Limited-cycle enrichment PCR with the Nextera Index 1 (N7xx) and Index 2 (N5xx) primers (typically 12 cycles of 95 C 10 s / 55 C 30 s / 72 C 30 s) appends the i7/P7 and i5/P5 ends; 0.6:1 AMPure XP cleanup, Qubit/Bioanalyzer QC, dilution to 2 nM and pooling folded in.
